texts.zh:
在巨型小行星[From.GetName]的地表下，我们发现了让人叹为观止的东西。有一台采矿设备安置在岩体上，一直挖到小行星地核深处！看情况它是被遗弃了，没有任何痕迹显示是谁留下的。

如果我们能够把这部机器停下，我们也许能够从中学习到制造它的科技，但一定要趁早，免得它被岩屑什么的压碎。
texts.en:
Deep within a crevice of the giant asteroid [From.GetName] we have found something astonishing. There is mining gear attached to the rock, digging itself into the vast depth of the asteroid! It stands abandoned, with no sign of who placed it there.

If we can stop the machine we might be able to learn something about the technology used to build it, but we must hurry before random debris crushes it.

texts.zh: 一个古老的挖掘机正在向巨大的小行星深处挖掘。如果我们能够在碎石压坏它之前停下它，我们也许可以学到一些建设方面有用的东西。
texts.en: An ancient excavator is digging deep into a giant asteroid. If we can stop it before it gets crushed by debris we might be able to learn something worthwhile about the construction.

texts.zh: 我们成功在挖掘机损坏之前制止了它。可惜它其实跟我们当前的设计非常类似，没有什么值得学习的。不过它挖出的洞可以让我们更轻易地找到贵重矿物。
texts.en: We managed to stop the excavator before it broke down. Sadly it is close to our own designs, and we can't really learn anything new from it. Thankfully the depths it carved out into the rock will make it easier to find valuable minerals.

texts.zh:
我们成功在挖掘机损坏之前制止了它。真是个神奇的机器，它的平滑的表层完全被钻石所覆盖。乍看之下，它似乎是一个整体，但其实只是做工精良，让人难以发现其连接处。

我们的工程师可以对它的一些科技进行逆向工程。
texts.en:
We managed to stop the excavator before it broke down. It's a remarkable piece of machinery, with a smooth surface covered in diamonds. At first glance the whole drill seems like one solid piece, but it's simply so well put together that you cannot notice the grooves and joints.

Our engineers will be able to reverse engineer some of this technology.

texts.zh: 一切都太迟了，我们未能阻止前进的钻头。它钻得太深，最后被重重的岩石压碎。
texts.en: We could not stop the rampaging drill before it was too late. It dug too deep and was eventually crushed under the weight of rocky detritus of its own creation.
